reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already resolves missing, single and ranged amounts with the furthest-from-zero rule.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the only redundancy is a '?? 0' that the helper's own null check already covers.

placement.why: The field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal in the API model layer.

scope.why: A one-line model change, a type field and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Simple and delegated to the canonical helper, though the output-only field is added as optional to APIScheduleEntity, which is also the create/update input type.
